ordinary_domain.input: Valid compact UTF-8 JSON admitted by the upstream bounded wire profile; source lexemes are preserved.
ordinary_domain.input_output_workspace: Private, pairwise disjoint buffers; input remains immutable for both passes.

output_contract.success: Only status 0 admits output length and emitted bytes.
output_contract.failure: Discard output and output length for every nonzero status; failed prefixes and failed length do not have an equivalence promise.
output_contract.valid_input_short_output_error_offset: Preserved from r2 byte-at-a-time candidate: first literal byte not emitted, or original structural input offset for punctuation/indentation.
output_contract.unadmitted_input: This formatter is not an independent full JSON parser. Diagnostic priority for malformed or unadmitted wire is not asserted equivalent to r2.

change.span_failure_code3: Use span_start + max(0, output_capacity - pre-span output_counter). A code-3 span failure implies remaining capacity is shorter than the admitted span.
change.other_span_failure: Retain previous end-offset reporting for non-code-3 statuses.
